messages:
Ava (AE): quick sync — ACME wants a 6-week pilot focusing on RAG for product search + embeddings. They care about quality (search relevance), latency, and unit cost. They asked about hosted vs dedicated pricing and security controls (SSO, data residency). Can we align scope, owners, and a timeline? Success criteria they gave: 1) MAP@10 >= 0.65 on their blind set, 2) p95 latency <300ms for 99th percentile traffic, 3) cost target under $0.003/token once tuned. They want prompt corpus + eval harness by EOW. Can SE/Eng commit to a Tue kickoff?

Diego (SE): I can lead SE. Tue morning works. Need the prompt set and a small sample of product metadata. Recommend starting hosted for velocity; switch to Dedicated if sustained QPS > 200 or strict VPC/KMS requirements. I'll draft a resourcing sheet. :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): I'll own milestones and deliverables. Proposed plan: Week0 kickoff, Week1 baseline ingestion & eval, Week2 prompt tuning + eval, Week3 integration tests, Week4 scale testing, Week6 final report + handoff. Add a canary rollout plan before production. Need expected QPS and max sequence length from the customer.

Jordan (Eng): We can spin up a dedicated test pool, but SRE and infra need lead time. For the latency target, what's the typical token length? >1024 tokens increases cost and latency. Also need clarification on data retention and PII handling — will ACME send PII in the queries? @sec-bot can we get the standard security summary to attach?

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can build the eval harness. Ask ACME for ~500 labeled queries for MAP@10 and 50 adversarial/failure prompts. Example eval command to run once data arrives:

```
python eval.py --data acme_queries.json --model redwood-v1 --metric map@10 --topk 10
```

I can scaffold the repo by EOD and push a template.

sec-bot: Attached security-questionnaire-v2 (link). We support SAML/OIDC SSO, KMS integrations, VPC peering for Private deployments, and audit logs. For dedicated/private, we can do customer-managed keys. I'll open a ticket for legal to share the DPA and SOC docs.

deploy-bot: ephemeral environment provisioned: rgp-acme-1838-test (creds expire in 7 days).

Ava (AE): good progress. Need explicit owners: Diego = SE lead (customer calls + runbook), Priya = PM (milestones + SOW), Jordan = Eng lead (infra requests + on-call). Action items: 1) Diego to share SE runbook + checklist by EOD, 2) Sam to commit eval harness skeleton by tomorrow, 3) Jordan to list infra reqs (GPU/CPU, network, retention) and open infra ticket. I'll draft an SOW and pricing options (hosted starter vs dedicated reserved). ACME also asked about an annual cap; will propose an annual commit for Dedicated in draft SOW.

Diego (SE): confirm SE on-call coverage for Tue/Wed morning kickoff + first two weeks for hand-holding. I'll post runbook link when ready.

Priya (PM): I'll circulate the SOW and a short success-criteria doc for customer sign-off.

Jordan (Eng): opening infra ticket and tagging eng-infra and eng-sre, will include expected CPU/GPU counts and network peering steps.

Ava (AE): I'll schedule kickoff for 2026-04-07 09:00 PT and send calendar invite to ACME and our team. Thanks all — let's close blockers before the call (esp security questionnaire and sample dataset). :rocket:
